cohort: Multiparous premenopausal women were divided into a healthy control group, a group diagnosed with stress urinary incontinence (SUI), and a group diagnosed with mixed urinary incontinence (MUI).
finding: Serum NGF and NT-3 levels were significantly lower in both incontinence subtypes compared to the control group, with a decrease in NGF levels specifically in MUI patients and NT-3 levels in SUI patients.
mod_finding: The number of vaginal deliveries was higher in women with incontinence subtypes compared to the control group.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at a single point in time in multiparous premenopausal women.
